entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: Transgender woman, khan of the Mardu Horde in Tarkir's past, called Who Smiles at Death.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who created the new timeline.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Event in the new timeline during which Alesha abolished the Mardu.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragon who invited the Mardu warriors to keep up with her in her travels.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Alesha is celebrated.

events.summary: Alesha chooses her grandmother's name at 16 and becomes Khan three years later.
events.quote: She chose the name of her grandmother at age 16 and became Khan 3 years later.

events.summary: Alesha slays a dragon with a single stroke and is named Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.
events.quote: For her deed of slaying a dragon with a single stroke

events.summary: In the new timeline, Alesha abolishes the Mardu in the Khanfall following Kolaghan's invitation.
events.quote: Alesha abolished the Mardu as part of the Khanfall of Tarkir

relations.quote: She ruled over the Mardu Horde with an iron fist and a steel blade.
